pages.text: The Ruins bleed into the Overworld in places that we call the Deep Dark, guarded by great typhlotic beasts we call Wardens, spreading on a substrate of calcified memories and experiences we call sculk. See how easily the sculk releases those experiences when broken? But with a gentle touch, a specimen of sculk can be captured live.
Perhaps, if one were to tease written words from this sculk, one could learn something about the Realm from which it spread.
